requirements.text: Implement customizable push notifications for various transaction types, including alerts for every transaction with details like amount, merchant name, and remaining balance.
Provide automated monthly spending breakdowns categorized by merchant type, visual trends over time, and the ability for users to set personalized budgets with alerts for approaching limits.
Incorporate both fingerprint and facial recognition for a seamless login experience, with an alternative secure PIN option and a brief onboarding guide to encourage user adoption.
Allow users to freeze/unfreeze their cards, set temporary spending limits, and manage card settings for online vs. in-store purchases, all presented in a user-friendly 'Card Management' section.
Enable in-app applications for personal loans and credit adjustments, simplifying the process and enhancing customer engagement.
Ensure all new features integrate with the existing core banking system through its current API layer without changes to the mainframe, potentially affecting implementation speed.
Adhere to PSD2, particularly regarding Strong Customer Authentication for biometric methods, and comply with Central Bank of Ireland regulations for lending features.
Ensure customer financial data is stored and processed within the European Economic Area, requiring robust data management practices.
Maintain backwards compatibility with the existing app version for at least six months during the transition.
Actively engage with customers for feedback throughout the development process, allowing for an iterative approach to refine user experience.
Ensure the development team is agile and responsive to unforeseen challenges during integration, allowing for a smooth transition.
Stay informed on emerging trends and competitor offerings to keep the app relevant in the evolving fintech landscape.
